pages.title: Blood Tank
pages.text: Find a Blood Tank in The Factory, repair the Broken Factory Control Panel with a wrench, and use an Empty Canister on the valve below.

pages.title: Redstone Circuit
pages.text: Mine 4 Industrial Metal Terminals in the Weather Factory structure, once you find the staircase to get up there, then craft a Redstone Assembly with the 4 Redstone Circuits you get

pages.title: Pegasus Device
pages.text: Use the Redstone Asssembly on the Pegasus Device in the Main Theater Room in the Rainbow Production section of the Weather Factory structure

pages.title: Blood Canister
pages.text: Take the Blood Canister to the Pegasus Device, then you can summon the boss.
